name: research-agent
description: Research-agent workflow in Claude Code: progress pane and status line from the research database, /research commands, a research_db tool for the model, workflow rules in the system prompt, and guards for frozen documents, the frozen harness and the database file.

toolsDir.title: research-agent directory
toolsDir.description: The research-agent repository holding tools/research_db.py, tools/build_site.py and the rules file.

projectDb.title: Project database
projectDb.description: research/<project-id>/research_tree.db of the project this session works on; empty turns the mod idle.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Interpreter with latticedb and jsonschema; empty means <toolsDir>/.venv/bin/python.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who this session is in the research team (<role>/<agent-id>), used by the research_db tool when a call names none.
